title: Generate Every Parenthesis Arrangement (Backtracking)
real_world_story: A puzzle designer needs every valid way to arrange N pairs of parentheses for a new bracket-placement level. Each arrangement must be balanced, and none may be missing.

real_world_connection.input_represents: The number of parenthesis pairs N
real_world_connection.query_represents: Every balanced arrangement to include in the level
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Trying '(' then ')' at each step and undoing choices that break validity

problem_statement: Given an integer N, generate all combinations of N pairs of well-formed parentheses. Return them in lexicographic order with '(' smaller than ')'.
task: Print every valid parentheses string, one per line, in lexicographic order. Print nothing extra when N is 0 except an empty line set (no output lines).
input_format: A single line containing integer N.
output_format: Print each valid combination on its own line in lexicographic order.

examples.explanation: There are 5 balanced arrangements of 3 pairs, listed in lexicographic order.

expected_algorithm.name: Backtracking
expected_algorithm.reason: Each position tries '(' or ')' while open and close counts stay valid, undoing each choice to explore the next option.

hint: Track how many '(' and ')' have been placed.
Add '(' when open < N and ')' when close < open.
real_world_takeaway: Backtracking enumerates every valid puzzle configuration without missing or repeating one.
